headline: Argentina Country Risk Rises Toward 800 Points Amid Global Market Slump
summary: JP Morgan's country risk index for Argentina climbed to 790 units as Argentine dollar-denominated sovereign bonds slid by nearly 2% during a broader global market retreat.
why: Country risk metrics dictate Argentina's borrowing costs and signal sovereign debt sustainability.

impacts.name: Argentina Country Risk Index
impacts.why: Rose toward 800 basis points as sovereign debt prices weakened.
